name: Funnel — lure to activated account
description: The whole acquisition path in one chart: a stranger pastes a URL, gets a preview, signs up, pays, claims their domain, connects their store, confirms their profile. The last step is the activation moment, not the signup.

name: Store connections abandoned
description: Merchants who reached the Shopify permission screen and did not come back. Read next to the funnel step above: a spike here is a copy or trust problem on that screen, not an acquisition problem.

name: Funnel
description: From a stranger pasting a URL to an account that has its first opportunities.
